iOS/iPadOS: Discovery adds Malay (ms), Malaysia (MY) and Singapore (SG). Movie and series Details checks source candidates only after opening a title, with episode-specific counts, manual recheck and incomplete/empty states. Short-lived results are reused by Watch to avoid repeat addon requests. No source checking or availability filter on search-result cards. Prior playback, subtitles, audio, diagnostics, recommendations and settings improvements remain included.
